review|cell-address#1.text: {"verdict":"approve","notes":"- All documented conversions and validation requirements are satisfied.\n- No contract defects found; CI and tests are green."}

review|csv-codec#1.text: {"verdict":"changes","notes":"- fromCsv does not reject trailing characters after a closing quote when they are whitespace: e.g. \"a\"   is accepted as a quoted field followed by spaces, but the contract requires malformed quoting to throw; the parser should reject any non-delimiter character after a closing quote (or explicitly define whitespace handling).\n- fromCsv returns no rows for an empty string; clarify whether an empty CSV must decode as [] or [[\"\"]] and add a test, since the contract does not specify this edge case."}

review|formula-parser#1.text: {"verdict":"changes","notes":"- Function arguments are incorrectly restricted to identifiers: `parseFormula('=SUM(A1)')` and `=SUM(A1:B2)` should be supported as range arguments, but the implementation rejects a single-cell argument and may reject valid range syntax depending on the contract.\n- The tokenizer/parser rejects valid numeric and cell-reference combinations that the documented contract implies, such as `=1.5`, `=A1:B3` handling is present, but function calls only accept identifier tokens; ensure all supported range forms are parsed consistently."}

review|formula-evaluator#1.text: {"verdict":"approve","notes":"- Meets the stated evaluation contract and acceptance cases.\n- Empty cells are coerced to 0, and existing #CYCLE/#DIV/0 errors propagate correctly.\n- Range aggregates and arithmetic error handling are implemented consistently."}
